BUILDINGS.name: Access road
BUILDINGS.blurb: Link the field to the city edge. Airlines want a way in.

BUILDINGS.name: Taxiway
BUILDINGS.blurb: Pavement jets and trucks follow.

BUILDINGS.name: Stand S
BUILDINGS.blurb: Small remote bay — walk or terminal-bus. Toggle Jetway for a pre-attached gate (pricier).

BUILDINGS.name: Stand M
BUILDINGS.blurb: Medium remote bay. Jetway toggle attaches a hall gate for fast board/deboard.

BUILDINGS.name: Stand L
BUILDINGS.blurb: Large remote bay — widebody / freighter / mil. Jetway toggle for attached gates.

BUILDINGS.name: Terminal bus depot
BUILDINGS.blurb: Apron buses ferry remote-stand pax. Without this, remote stands walk the pavement (slow + traffic).

BUILDINGS.name: De-ice pad
BUILDINGS.blurb: Glycol pad beside taxi/strip. Storm holds clear when De-ice ops is researched.

BUILDINGS.name: Terminal shell
BUILDINGS.blurb: Empty 2×2 hall. Furnish rooms yourself.

BUILDINGS.name: Snack bar
BUILDINGS.blurb: Meals and catering.

BUILDINGS.name: Bag sort
BUILDINGS.blurb: Makeup hub — paint Belt tiles to the hall and stands.

BUILDINGS.name: Bag belt
BUILDINGS.blurb: Link hall ↔ bag sort ↔ stand. Break the chain → late bags + Standing dips.

BUILDINGS.name: Fuel farm
BUILDINGS.blurb: Field level 1. Beside pavement. Sign a carrier and buy loads.

BUILDINGS.name: Catering kitchen
BUILDINGS.blurb: Field level 2. Cooks meals for the galley trucks. Place it beside a road.

BUILDINGS.name: Vehicle depot
BUILDINGS.blurb: Field level 2. Fuel, galley, bag, and bus trucks stage here. A second depot adds another fleet.

BUILDINGS.name: Fire station
BUILDINGS.blurb: ARFF cover. Airlines will not sign without it.

BUILDINGS.name: Police post
BUILDINGS.blurb: Patrols and security. Cuts threat risk.

BUILDINGS.name: Cargo shed
BUILDINGS.blurb: For Umazon, UPPS, and EXFED freighters. City trucks deliver here after the guard post.

BUILDINGS.name: Guard post
BUILDINGS.blurb: Screens city cargo trucks on the access road. Missing post = queues, denied entry, On-time dips.

BUILDINGS.name: Control tower
BUILDINGS.blurb: Clears traffic faster and unlocks busier airlines. Does not print money.

BUILDINGS.name: Maintenance hangar
BUILDINGS.blurb: Overnight checks. Raises reputation when stands are busy.

BUILDINGS.name: Helipad
BUILDINGS.blurb: Medevac and executive choppers land here. Needs fire coverage nearby in spirit.

BUILDINGS.name: Airport inn
BUILDINGS.blurb: Budget landside inn — pax night fees only. Idle beds still cost upkeep.

BUILDINGS.name: Business hotel
BUILDINGS.blurb: Mid-rise landside hotel — overnight fees from pax. Empty = expense bleed.

BUILDINGS.name: Airport resort
BUILDINGS.blurb: Premium resort tower — high night fees when full, heavy upkeep when empty.

BUILDINGS.name: Small lot
BUILDINGS.blurb: Surface lot + booth. Fees when pax park; Toggle Short/Long. Idle costs.

BUILDINGS.name: Large lot
BUILDINGS.blurb: Big lot + canopy. Passenger fees only — empty lots bleed upkeep.

BUILDINGS.name: Parking garage
BUILDINGS.blurb: Multi-level garage. Highest park fees + highest idle expense.

BUILDINGS.name: Underground park
BUILDINGS.blurb: Underground portal. Good fees when used; lights/pumps cost when idle.

BUILDINGS.name: Bus curb
BUILDINGS.blurb: City bus stop on a road edge. Budget pax arrive here — missing curb angers them.

BUILDINGS.name: Rail station
BUILDINGS.blurb: Passenger rail hall on the city link. Needs City rail first. Business pax love it.
